triggers: a kernel on AMD MI308X (CDNA3 / gfx942) risks the '2. Reusing BF16/F16 References For The FP8 PTPC Gate' trap

payload.goal: Avoid a known trap on AMD MI308X (CDNA3 / gfx942): 2. Reusing BF16/F16 References For The FP8 PTPC Gate

problem.statement: Pitfalls: FlyDSL FP8 PTPC Fused MoE on MI308X -- 2. Reusing BF16/F16 References For The FP8 PTPC Gate

payload.attempted: Use BF16 or F16-derived reference rows when evaluating FP8 PTPC progress.
payload.lesson: Use the corrected FP8 measured-byte CM2 load-only proxy for this gate. BF16/F16-derived rows are invalid for FP8 PTPC acceptance.

established_fact.mechanism: The task66 contract explicitly models FP8 GEMM input reads, BF16 stage/output activations, F32 scales, I32 metadata, and BF16 output atomic read-modify-write traffic.

payload.observed: The apparent target can become easier or inconsistent with the byte model, causing false pass/fail decisions.
payload.root_cause: The task66 contract explicitly models FP8 GEMM input reads, BF16 stage/output activations, F32 scales, I32 metadata, and BF16 output atomic read-modify-write traffic.
